text:
Mari K.: Hey team — my LH flight to Berlin got rescheduled overnight, airline offered a different routing with a change fee of EUR 95. I had to book a new ticket on a different carrier to make the meeting.
Mari K.: Questions: 1) Is the change fee reimbursable? 2) How do I submit this if part of the charge hit my personal card and the rest hit the company card? 3) Do I lose per-diem for the night that got canceled? :airplane:
travel-bot: Automated note — if booking change was initiated by airline (schedule change/refund/voluntary rebook), please attach the airline notice. Non-refundable fees typically handled case-by-case.
People Ops (Emma): Short answers:
People Ops (Emma): 1) Change fees are reimbursable if they were unavoidable (e.g., you rebooked because original arrival missed key customer meeting) OR you paid because you chose a different routing without airline-caused schedule change. If airline issued a free rebooking, we don't reimburse fees.
People Ops (Emma): 2) If company card was charged and later refunded by airline, we don't need a personal expense. If you paid on personal card, submit an expense with the original charge + refund evidence. Finance will net refunds.
People Ops (Emma): 3) Per-diem: Redwood issues per-diem per overnight stayed in destination. If the overnight was canceled and you didn't stay there, that night's per-diem is not payable. If you still stayed but lost meals due to schedule, follow the partial-day rules below.
Finance Team: Quick process notes:
Finance Team: - Please upload the airline charge receipt and the airline confirmation (email or screenshot) showing the refund/credit or schedule change.
Finance Team: - When submitting, use these fields exactly in the expense portal:
Finance Team: ```
expense_type: travel_change_fee
amount: 95.00
currency: EUR
merchant: Airline or booking site name
date: 2025-06-17
payment_method: personal_card (or company_card)
attachments: receipt_pdf, airline_notice
note: PNR: ABC123 — reason: rebook due to carrier schedule change / meeting constraint
```
Finance Team: - If a refund posts later to your company card, please comment on the expense with the refund transaction id and we will close the claim as reimbursed to company.
Jason B.: FWIW I had this last quarter. Paid EUR 120 on personal card, got EUR 120 credit two weeks later. I submitted the expense with both original receipt and the refund screenshot; finance marked it "refund pending" and then closed it once refund hit the corporate ledger. Works cleanly.
Olga P.: For currency conversion — do we use the FX on the date of charge or date of reimbursement? Also any VAT reclaim steps?
Finance Team: Use the exchange rate on the date of the charge (supplier charge date). We accept XE or OANDA screenshots. VAT: if VAT is shown on the original receipt and you have an itemized invoice, finance can evaluate reclaim, but typically small change fees are not worth VAT reclaim overhead. Attach invoices if available.
Mari K.: Thanks. One follow-up on per-diem: I ended up traveling back same day earlier than planned and missed the evening meal. Does Redwood do half-day meal for same-day travel?
People Ops (Emma): Yes — policy summary:
People Ops (Emma): - Overnight present in destination = full per-diem for that day.
People Ops (Emma): - Same-day travel (no overnight): if away > 6 hours — eligible for 50% meal allowance; <= 6 hours — no per-diem.
People Ops (Emma): - If itinerary change removed an overnight that you had already been paid for in advance, submit a note and we will prorate on the final expense reconciliation.
People Ops (Emma): Example: scheduled 2 nights (N1,N2) but N2 canceled before you stayed => you keep per-diem for N1 only. If you were paid N2 in advance on a travel advance, we will deduct prorated amount from final settlement or refund to company.
Mari K.: Perfect. One last thing — is there any pre-approval required for change fees > $250?
People Ops (Emma): Yes — any out-of-policy or > $250 requires manager + People Ops preapproval. If urgent, ping me and I can preapprove up to $250 for unplanned rebookings. For larger amounts, attach manager sign-off in the expense notes.
Mari K.: Great, thanks everyone. I'll upload receipts and the airline notice now. :thumbsup:
travel-bot: Reminder: attach file types PDF/JPEG/PNG, max 10MB per file.
